up: Retrieve all distinct molecules that are approved drugs (max_phase = 4) and also have at least one recorded drug indication with a max phase of 1. Return the ChEMBL ID and preferred name of the molecule.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND di.max_phase_for_ind = 1;
